original_poem:
ஆகாய கங்கை, என்னைச் சூழும்  
அந்தி நிலா நெஞ்சில் ஊரும்  
விண்ணின் நீர் பூமியில் சேரும்  
கண்ணின் பாசம் காதலாய் தோன்றும்
translated_poem:
The sky river surrounds me,  
The twilight moon seeps into my heart.  
The water from the sky meets the earth,  
Love blossoms in the bonds of the eyes.

stanzas.loss_note: ஆகாய கங்கை (Aagaya Gangai) is not merely 'sky river' but a specific Tamil epithet for the Milky Way and also an invocation of the celestial Ganga descending from the heavens — a cosmological image rooted in Puranic tradition; the translation flattens this into a generic natural image.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: twilight longing slowly pervading the interior self
the divine descending to unite with the earthly beloved
the gaze as the threshold where attachment becomes love

cultural_entities.translation_note: Rendered as 'sky river' — loses the Puranic resonance of the celestial Ganga descending from the heavens and its Tamil epithet for the Milky Way as a sacred cosmological entity.
